title: Supply, Installation, testing and commissioning of the CCTV system at Mallipattinam, Ammapattinam, Passipattinam, Pamban and Vembar Lighthouses
summary: GeM two-packet BOQ bid by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of CCTV systems (cameras, NVRs, PoE switches, cabling, monitors, UPS, racks, poles) at five stations in Tamil Nadu.

money.notes: Estimated bid value Rs 31,14,869. EMD Rs 62,300 (advisory bank State Bank of India), also payable by DD or FDR in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, with hard copy within 5 days of bid end/opening; MSE exemption only for manufacturers/service providers. MII and MSE purchase preference apply; only Class-I and Class-II local suppliers eligible. Option clause +/-25% of quantity.

period.warranty: 2 years from final acceptance / completion of installation, commissioning and testing

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover (3 years) Rs 15 lakh
3 years past experience of same/similar category products to Central/State Govt/PSU (buyer ATC says 2 years)
Past performance: supplied same/similar products for 80% of bid quantity in one of last three financial years to Govt/PSU
No MSE or startup exemption for experience and turnover
Documents: experience, past performance, turnover, ATC certificates, OEM authorisation, additional documents, BoQ specification compliance
Installation/commissioning/testing by OEM, OEM-certified resource or OEM-authorised reseller; service centres near consignee locations
Vendor code documents: PAN, GSTIN, cancelled cheque, EFT mandate
specs: 5 MP bullet or dome cameras; 32-channel NVR; 10 TB surveillance HDD
8-port and 16-port PoE switches; CAT 6 STP/SFTP and CAT 6 armoured cable
43 inch LED monitor; 1 kVA and 0.6 kVA UPS with minimum 30 minutes backup
4U 500D wall-mount network racks; 6 m SS poles; HDPE pipe trenching to 45 cm depth
notes: Standard GeM bid document; technical specification, BOQ detail and buyer ATC attachments are links only (not included). Title and bid text name Pamban Lighthouse, but the fourth consignee in every item is Rameswaram DGPS Station; no Pamban consignee appears. Item quantities sum to the printed total quantity 9215. Cable/trench quantity units not printed. Bid end 29-01-2025 17:00, opening 17:30; pre-bid 21-01-2025 15:00 at the Chennai office. Evaluation: total value wise, two packet, no reverse auction. Named consignee officers and buyer's personal-style e-mail omitted.
